problem: An external project worker must create one scoped working note with attributable provenance, retrieve its stable ID, search it, stop/restart the provider, then retrieve it again without direct HTTP/database/framework coupling.
existingInsufficient: Frozen echo is side-effect-free; example.records is opaque replaceable key/value without governed scope/provenance/candidate semantics or search. Agent-execution and decision-evaluate do not provide durable governed memory. Changing their semantics is prohibited.
abstraction: Exactly one generic working-candidate capability with create/get/search, explicit scope as requested target not authority, stable opaque IDs, bounded text/source provenance. No broad memory family, HTTP dispatch, provider-specific table/schema names or promotion/export/admin operations.
providers: Governed MemoryV4 shared-domain SQLite adapter (authorized planned implementation, not yet built)
Any independent governed candidate provider satisfying these public semantics; no requirement to implement one speculatively
consumers: External public-SDK project working-note consumer; create/get/search/restart/get with no MemoryV4, FastAPI or SQLite imports
alternatives: Rejected repurposing echo or generic records because existing contracts lack governance; rejected HTTP wrapping/store bypass and a generic memory API. Keep canonical exchange an explicit restricted operator task, outside this worker capability.
security: Trusted Host OperationContext.caller supplies identity; operator mapping narrows to actor/data-root/permissions. Body contains no identity/grants. Domain reevaluates scope/create-working/read/search and audits writes/search. Source provenance is asserted content, not authentication. Working-only output cannot promote canonical truth. Deadlines/cancellation do not guarantee rollback; explicit same-key retry only.
scopes: Existing application/session Catalog labels and Host scope/grants unchanged. Requested memory scope must equal/descend separately mapped data-root; visible ancestor candidates only; no public opt-in or sibling leakage. Catalog permission metadata grants nothing.
compatibility: Additive new candidate descriptor/proposal only; original contracts/catalog snapshots/Foundation unchanged. Independent distinct-parent review before PROPOSED; actual conformance plus existing maintainer transition before EXPERIMENTAL snapshot. No new public language binding.
genericRationale: Scoped attributable working text candidates and lexical retrieval are reusable across project workers/providers; no tenant names, MemoryV4 endpoints or SQLite representation in the contract.
